script: local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))() local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "oob!Hub🎟️", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "OrionTest"}) --[[ Name = - The name of the UI. HidePremium = - Whether or not the user details shows Premium status or not. SaveConfig = - Toggles the config saving in the UI. ConfigFolder = - The name of the folder where the configs are saved. IntroEnabled = false - Whether or not to show the intro animation. IntroText = - Text to show in the intro animation. IntroIcon = - URL to the image you want to use in the intro animation. Icon = - URL to the image you want displayed on the window. CloseCallback = - Function to execute when the window is closed. ]] local Tab = Window:MakeTab({ Name = "||Misc", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998", PremiumOnly = false }) --[[ Name = - The name of the tab. Icon = - The icon of the tab. PremiumOnly = - Makes the tab accessible to Sirus Premium users only. ]] local Section = Tab:AddSection({ Name = "OP battlegrounds" }) --[[ Name = - The name of the section. ]] OrionLib:MakeNotification({ Name = "Welcome!", Content = "Welcome to my hub!", Image = "rbxassetid://4483345998", Time = 5 }) --[[ Title = - The title of the notification. Content = - The content of the notification. Image = - The icon of the notification. Time = - The duration of the notfication. ]] Tab:AddButton({ Name = "🎉||No Cooldown", Callback = function() Game.Players.LocalPlayer.NoCD.Value=true end }) --[[ Name = - The name of the button. Callback = - The function of the button. ]] Tab:AddButton({ Name = "🎊||Awakening ", Callback = function() Game.Players.LocalPlayer.AwakenBar.Value=200 end }) --[[ Name = - The name of the button. Callback = - The function of the button. ]] Tab:AddButton({ Name = "👊||No DashCD", Callback = function() Game.Players.LocalPlayer.NoDashCD.Value=true end }) --[[ Name = - The name of the button. Callback = - The function of the button. ]] --[[ Name = - The name of the button. Callback = - The function of the button. ]]loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ajsobs/OP-battlegrounds-script/refs/heads/main/OP%20battlegrounds%20script?token=GHSAT0AAAAAAC3HO5DDCE6WEGSOO5FCILQMZ2LNFCQ"))()
